name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: A file with its upload status as a row or a tile, with media, actions, and a group that scrolls.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { X } from "@lucide/vue";
import type { AttachmentActionProps, AttachmentActionSlots } from "./types.ts";

const { label = "Remove", disabled = false } = defineProps<AttachmentActionProps>();
defineSlots<AttachmentActionSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" data-slot="attachment-action" :aria-label="label" :disabled="disabled">
    <slot><X aria-hidden="true" /></slot>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs, useSlots } from "vue";
import type { AttachmentTriggerSlots } from "./types.ts";

// The trigger covers the whole attachment, so a click on any part of it opens the file. Give it an accessible name.
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
defineSlots<AttachmentTriggerSlots>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const slots = useSlots();
// An attachment group scrolls sideways and clips a ring outside the card, so the focus ring goes inside.
const part = computed(() => ({ ...attrs, "data-focus-inset": "", "data-slot": "attachment-trigger" }));
const children = () => slots.default?.();
</script>

<template>
  <slot name="render" :props="part" :children="children">
    <button type="button" v-bind="part"><slot /></button>
  </slot>
</template>
